title: Organiser news: 2026 refreshment and hydration service (13 points, own-container rule)
publisher: A.S.O. — Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris official news
claims: The 2026 course had 13 refreshment points: 9 full stations (food + drinks), 4 water points, 1 full station at the finish and 2 Ta Energy electrolyte-drink stations.
Full stations were 160 m long; the 2026 edition added stations and shortened gaps between them, especially in the second half; cooling systems are set up in case of high temperatures.
No cups or bottles are distributed on the course; runners must bring their own container (cup, flask or hydration pack); volunteers and refill stations support refilling.

An elite-style bottle system for runners targeting under 2h50 requires a start in the preferred wave (start by 8:03 a.m.) and a 4:01/km pace; used bottles are collected and reused; bottles may be discarded only in designated zones 150 m after stations, otherwise disqualification applies.
